title: Projection right tensor action at common coefficients
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, an integer $n\ge1$, and an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ containing $E$. Let $S$ be a six-functor datum at these coefficients [def-sf-datum], with the specified operation and comparison data [def-fix-six-functor-datum].

Work at $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ in the common finite-stage categories $D^b_c(T,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients].

Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes and supply a compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to Y)$ with $j$ open, $p$ proper and $pj=f$. Write $F=Rf_!^c$, $U=Lf^*$, and $P(K,L)=\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,L}^c:FK\otimes L\to F(K\otimes UL)$ for the datum's actual compactification projection, namely the proper counit projection followed by the open tensor comparison [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates, def-exchange-projection]. Write $a_T(A,B,C):(A\otimes B)\otimes C\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes(B\otimes C)$ for the canonical tensor associator conjugated by the datum's tensor normalization, and $\mu_f(L,N):U(L\otimes N)\xrightarrow{\sim}UL\otimes UN$ for the canonical normalized tensor-pullback comparison [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Then, for every $K\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ and $L,N\in D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$, with no additional finite-Tor restriction on these inputs,
$$\begin{aligned}
P(K\otimes UL,N)\circ(P(K,L)\otimes1_N)
={}&F\bigl(a_X(K,UL,UN)^{-1}\bigr)\circ F(1_K\otimes\mu_f(L,N))\\
&\circ P(K,L\otimes N)\circ a_Y(FK,L,N).
\end{aligned}$$
Both sides are morphisms $(FK\otimes L)\otimes N\to F((K\otimes UL)\otimes UN)$. The two final images under $F$ are separate composites. All tensors, associators and pullbacks are the specified completed integral, rationalized, or common-stage operations, according to the coefficient stage. This is an equality of projection maps without an extra invertibility hypothesis. Taking $N$ to be the degree-zero constant quotient $(\Lambda/J)_Y$ for an ideal $J\subseteq\Lambda$ gives reduction inside the original coefficient category; $UN$ is its canonical pulled-back coefficient object. The assertion is for arbitrary $N$, not only constant quotients.

Construction material for a future worker, not a proof certification: prove the proper counit tensor-action identity by transposing both composites, and the open unit tensor identity on pure tensors; paste those identities for the actual compactification map. At the integral stage keep the equation in the coherent system with its completion units before applying the total derived inverse limit. Localization and common-field inclusion preserve that completed equation with the specified tensor associators. No finite-Tor restriction on N or L is present in these exact source declarations; do not silently add one. Right tensor by a constant quotient is reduction inside the original category, not a functor reducing a rational coefficient object to a finite coefficient ring.

Verbatim retained old parent argument, in source order:
For coefficients, [prop-sf-pf-reduction] supplies the finite reduction square on the finite-Tor domains. At field stages use the integral representatives, rationalization and common-stage comparisons of [thm-sf-pf-field]. The (A5) comparisons [def-sf-datum] and primitive-map data [def-exchange-projection] satisfy the intertwining and cocycle hypotheses of [lem-sf-pf-coefficient-realization-transport]. It carries the proved equal composites and their unit identifications to the specified coefficient/site maps; its cocycles give coefficient naturality. [thm-sf-pf-proetale] identifies the realized projection with the same proper counit projection followed by the open tensor map. Integral commutativity was proved directly in step 2; fields use chosen integral representatives, never reduction of field objects. For the finite all-ideal clause, [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] gives the actual component and its recorded source and target realization comparisons. Conjugate by these comparisons and cancel the inverse/hom composites; the fully faithful preimage equation for the realization equivalence identifies the arrow with fixedComponent. Its tensor-coordinate evaluation is the same canonical proper/open projection. Apply the expanded general coefficient-category compactification tensor-action identity [lem-sf-projection-tensor-coordinate-action], proved from the existing generic library calculation in [lem-pur-finite-projection-action-laws] with third input the degree-zero constant quotient A/J. Functorial preservation of composition separates the pullback tensor comparison and the inverse target associator. The quotient is arbitrary; no perfectness or flatness assumption is imposed. The remaining coefficient clauses retain the preceding plan.

proof.text: Use the specified common-stage categories and actual maps, rather than an arbitrary isomorphic projection.
